title: Nano-encapsulated Senecio glaucus L. essential oil with potent antioxidant, anticancer, and wound-healing properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19094-19108
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09763K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zainab H. Hussein, Sherif F. Hammad, Kuniyoshi Shimizu, Amr A. Nassrallah, Hesham S. M. Soliman
Nano-encapsulation of Senecio glaucus L. essential oil enhanced its stability and bioactivity. The formulation exhibited potent antioxidant, anticancer, and wound-healing effects, supported by TEM characterization and gene expression analysis.
